project.title: Standardized Custom Kitchen Line for Small Apartments
project.objective: Design and pilot a modular custom kitchen furniture line optimized for small apartments, with repeatable build steps and coordinated delivery.
deliverables: Set of standardized modular kitchen cabinet designs with cut lists
Prototyped full kitchen set installed in a test apartment
Workshop production workflow and quality checklist for the new line
Packaging and handling guidelines for safe transport and installation
Cost and time estimate sheet per kitchen configuration
Photo and measurement documentation for marketing and sales teams
constraints: All modules must fit standard small-apartment layouts with max ceiling height of 2.6m
Use only currently approved wood types, finishes, and hardware from existing suppliers
Prototype must be fully built and installed within 21 days
Designs must be compatible with existing workshop machines and tools
Packaging must allow safe manual handling by two workers and fit in standard vans

risks.risk: Modules do not fit common small-apartment constraints, causing rework on site.
risks.mitigation: Collect and validate standard room measurements upfront and build a measurement checklist.

risks.risk: New designs are too complex for current tools, slowing production.
risks.mitigation: Limit joinery and shapes to what can be done with existing machines; run a test build before finalizing.

risks.risk: Transport damage to finished cabinets due to inadequate packaging.
risks.mitigation: Define reinforced packaging standards and run a trial move with dummy units.

risks.risk: Finish and color variations between batches reduce perceived quality.
risks.mitigation: Standardize finishing sequence, drying times, and record finish batches per order.

themes.theme: Modular cabinet design and cut optimization
themes.why_relevant: Directly impacts material usage, build time, and ability to standardize the new kitchen line.

themes.theme: Workshop workflow and division of tasks
themes.why_relevant: Cabinet makers must align on who designs, cuts, assembles, finishes, and documents work.

themes.theme: Measurement and installation constraints on site
themes.why_relevant: Real apartment conditions drive design limits and avoid rework during installation.
Protects finished pieces and ensures they can be moved safely into small apartments.
Ensures every kitchen in the line looks and feels the same despite different makers.

themes.theme: Time and cost estimation for repeatable jobs
themes.why_relevant: Needed so sales and planning can quote and schedule the new kitchen line reliably.

backlog.task: Define standard small-apartment kitchen layouts and key measurements
definition_of_done: At least three typical layout types documented with sketches
Measurement checklist created for walls, ceiling, plumbing, and appliances
Constraints validated with installation technician and move coordinator

backlog.task: Create modular cabinet design set and detailed cut lists
definition_of_done: Base, wall, and tall cabinet modules designed in CAD
Cut lists produced for each module using current board sizes
Hardware and joinery types specified for each module

backlog.task: Prototype build of one full small-apartment kitchen set
definition_of_done: All modules cut, assembled, and dry-fitted in workshop
Any build issues logged with photos and notes
Adjustments to design or cut lists proposed based on prototype

backlog.task: Define finishing process and color standards for the line
definition_of_done: Two to three standard color/finish combinations selected
Step-by-step finishing sequence documented
Sample boards produced and labeled for reference

backlog.task: Design packaging and protection method for transport
definition_of_done: Packaging materials and methods defined for each module type
Drop and scratch tests performed on at least one packed module
Packaging instructions documented with photos

backlog.task: Plan loading, delivery, and on-site handling sequence
definition_of_done: Loading order defined to match installation sequence
Handling constraints (max weight per piece, team size) documented
Checklist for move coordinator created and reviewed

backlog.task: Install prototype kitchen in test apartment and capture feedback
definition_of_done: Prototype kitchen fully installed and leveled
Fit issues and on-site adjustments recorded
Photos and notes shared with workshop team

backlog.task: Create quality control checklist for production and installation
definition_of_done: Checklist covers dimensions, joints, finish, and hardware
Separate sections for workshop and on-site checks
Checklist tested on prototype build and refined

backlog.task: Estimate standard build and install times per module
definition_of_done: Time tracking done on prototype build and install
Average times per module type calculated
Summary shared with sales and planning stakeholders

backlog.task: Prepare photo and measurement pack for sales and marketing
definition_of_done: High-quality photos of prototype kitchen taken
Key dimensions and module options summarized
Pack stored in shared location and linked in channel

backlog.task: Document safety guidelines for workshop and on-site work
definition_of_done: Risks for cutting, lifting, and installing identified
Safe handling and PPE requirements listed
Guidelines reviewed with workshop supervisor

backlog.task: Consolidate final standard for the modular kitchen line
definition_of_done: All design, process, and quality docs updated after prototype
Open issues list reviewed and closed or parked
Team agreement on version 1.0 of the standard recorded

artifacts.title: Production and Installation Quality Control Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Step-by-step checks for workshop build and on-site installation of the kitchen line.

artifacts.title: Finishing and Color Standard for Modular Kitchen Line
artifacts.used_for: Defines approved finishes, application steps, and sample references.

artifacts.title: Packaging, Loading, and Handling Procedure
artifacts.used_for: Instructions for protecting, loading, and moving cabinets into small apartments.

artifacts.title: Time and Cost Estimates per Module
artifacts.used_for: Summarizes average build and install times and material usage for planning and sales.

artifacts.title: Prototype Kitchen Installation Report
artifacts.used_for: Captures photos, issues, and lessons learned from the test apartment install.

artifacts.title: Workshop and On-Site Safety Guidelines
artifacts.used_for: Lists safety practices, PPE, and lifting rules for the new kitchen line work.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on target layouts, measurements, and main constraints for the kitchen line.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the modular small-apartment kitchen project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the 2–3 standard small-apartment kitchen layouts to support in version 1.0.
Approve the measurement checklist structure for on-site data collection.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the initial modular cabinet set, cut lists, and compatible finishes.
threads_plan.trigger: First draft of cabinet module designs and cut lists shared in the channel.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the list of base, wall, and tall modules for the prototype build.
Choose the initial set of finishes and colors to use on the prototype.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and track the prototype build in the workshop, including quality checks.
threads_plan.trigger: Start of cutting and assembly work for the prototype kitchen.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final workshop build sequence and division of tasks.
Agree on which quality checks are mandatory before loading for transport.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on packaging, loading, and on-site handling for the prototype install.
threads_plan.trigger: Prototype modules ready for finishing and preparation for transport.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard packaging method and loading order for the line.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review the test apartment installation and close version 1.0 of the standard.
threads_plan.trigger: Completion of the prototype kitchen installation in the test apartment.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which changes from the prototype become part of the final standard.

channel_rituals: Daily short async standup where each cabinet maker posts yesterday/today/blockers.
Twice-weekly workshop check-in thread to sync on build progress and issues.
Post-installation review thread after the prototype install to capture lessons learned.
Weekly safety and quality reminder post referencing current checklists and incidents.
